title: Sankat Saathi (संकट साथी)
description: AI-powered humanitarian flood relief platform that optimizes emergency citizen SOS requests, explains urgency scores, and coordinates warehouse supply dispatches.
overview: Sankat Saathi (संकट साथी) is an AI-powered disaster management and humanitarian logistics platform engineered for flood-prone regions. Backed by IBM Z and Supabase, it automates citizen SOS requests, detects duplicates, scores urgency using explainable AI models, calculates Haversine geospatial proximity to relief centers, and dynamically coordinates warehouse inventories to dispatch life-saving supplies.
problem: During catastrophic flood events, emergency helplines are overwhelmed with duplicate SOS calls, supply dispatches are delayed by guesswork, and relief depots struggle to prioritize life-threatening incidents without transparent triage scoring.
solution: An end-to-end humanitarian platform combining automated GPS geocoding, explainable AI urgency scoring (+55 severity, logarithmic population scaling), and Haversine distance calculations to pair high-priority distress calls with the nearest stocked relief depot in real time.
intendedFor: Disaster response teams, state relief commissioners, field NGOs, and flood-affected citizens.
role: Lead Full-Stack & Systems Architecture, React + Tailwind Frontend, AI Recommendation Engine, Supabase Schema & Workflows.
features: Citizen Emergency SOS Portal with automated GPS geocoding and special needs categorization.
Explainable AI Urgency Scoring weighing incident severity (+55), population, and wait times.
Haversine Geospatial Allocation mapping requests to closest relief depots.
Multi-stage dispatch pipeline: Approved → Preparing → In transit → Delivered.
Shelter & Relief Camp Directory with real-time capacity metrics.
Enterprise PostgreSQL RLS security isolating operational views.
architecture: Built on a high-throughput microservices architecture. Citizen SOS requests arrive through the client-side React portal and are validated via an edge proxy. Ingested payloads trigger asynchronous triage workers running on IBM Z LinuxONE. The scoring engine evaluates population density, medical severity, and wait time penalties, computing real-time geospatial distance matrix against active depot inventory records.
challenges: Mitigating duplicate SOS spam during peak influx while guaranteeing sub-second geospatial routing across distributed relief camps. Solved by implementing spatial hashing (clustering coordinates within a 150m radius) and logarithmic wait-time decay in the scoring algorithm.

title: ATLAS
description: Personal life operating system featuring an intelligent college attendance & bunk margin simulator, CGPA planner, Pomodoro focus engine, and cognitive AI morning brief.
overview: Atlas is an all-in-one personal life operating system and cognitive student workspace. Unifying academic management, daily habits, deep work, and financial control with an AI assistant, attendance bunk calculator, CGPA grade planner, time-blocking calendar, and cashflow ledger.
problem: Students juggle disjointed apps for attendance, timetables, grade calculation, habit tracking, and personal finance, leading to cognitive fatigue, missed attendance minimums, and fragmented daily productivity.
solution: A unified, single-pane-of-glass PWA with an intelligent attendance bunk margin simulator ('Safe to miss 2 classes' or 'Must attend 3 to keep 75%'), weighted university CGPA predictor, and Pomodoro deep-work engine.
intendedFor: University students, engineers, and ambitious knowledge workers.
role: Solo Creator & Architect — Full-Stack Engineering, Algorithmic Logic, and UI/UX Design.
features: College Attendance Tracker with Bunk Margin Simulator.
Academic CGPA / SGPA Forecaster with university grade-weighting.
Pomodoro Deep-Work Focus Engine with ambient sound generator.
Daily Habit Streaks & Eisenhower Priority Task Board.
AI Assistant with voice-enabled chat and smart daily morning briefings.
Student Cashflow & Expense Ledger with category-level burn rate analytics.
architecture: Engineered as an offline-first Progressive Web App. Client state is managed reactively with indexed storage fallbacks, syncing bi-directionally to Supabase PostgreSQL when network connectivity is established. Mathematical modules compute attendance bunk thresholds deterministically without server round-trips.
challenges: Accurately projecting multi-semester CGPA across variable credit weights while ensuring instantaneous offline responsiveness on mobile devices with zero lag. Addressed via local IndexedDB caching, Web Workers for heavy recalculations, and optimistic UI updates.

title: Portfolio project
description: Modern personal portfolio with interactive 3D WebGL hero sphere, LinkedIn OAuth testimonials, and dedicated Engineering Lab deep-dives.
overview: A modern, high-performance personal portfolio engineered with Next.js, Three.js, React Three Fiber, and Framer Motion. Features an interactive 3D particle sphere responding to cursor and gyroscope motion, secure OAuth testimonials with LinkedIn/Google, and an integrated Engineering Lab.
problem: Traditional portfolio sites are static, forgettable resumes that fail to demonstrate real frontend engineering capability, 3D graphics performance, and interactive system design.
solution: An immersive, responsive 3D WebGL web experience achieving 60fps across mobile and desktop, coupled with secure NextAuth authentication, Supabase real-time database integration, and an admin management suite.
intendedFor: Developers, recruiters, engineering managers, and tech collaborators.
role: Creator, Frontend Architect, and 3D Visual Designer.
features: Interactive 3D particle sphere with reactive mouse & gyroscope orientation controls.
Dual theme engine supporting sleek dark mode and warm editorial day mode with zero flash.
Authenticated social testimonials system using NextAuth with Google and LinkedIn OAuth.
Comprehensive Admin Control Suite for live content, telemetry, and project management.
Dedicated Engineering Lab architecture deep-dives and live deployment preview engine.
architecture: Built on Next.js App Router with server-side rendering for critical SEO tags and client-side WebGL canvas mounts. A unified theme provider coordinates global CSS custom properties across 3D shaders, DOM elements, and admin overlays.
challenges: Balancing rich WebGL vertex distortion and starfield parallax animations with mobile battery life and fast First Contentful Paint. Optimized through dynamic geometry LOD scaling and pointer-event throttles.

team.name: Pavan Kumar
team.contribution: Interactive 3D UI, real-time database architecture, and authentication flows.

title: Weather App
description: Real-time weather dashboard with live forecasts, air quality, and interactive maps.
overview: Interactive real-time weather intelligence dashboard tracking dynamic microclimates, AQI telemetry, and predictive rainfall models.
problem: Standard weather widgets lack granular atmospheric telemetry and low-latency radar tracking.
solution: Architected high-throughput weather dashboard integrating multi-source radar vectors and instant geospatial search.
intendedFor: Meteorology enthusiasts, daily commuters, and environmental researchers.
features: Live atmospheric pressure, temperature, and AQI monitoring
Interactive vector radar and precipitation velocity mapping
7-day dynamic forecasting with hourly micro-trend visualization
Low-power lightweight responsive UI optimized for mobile devices
contributions: Engineered Express microservice proxying Open-Meteo REST APIs
Designed minimal dark/light responsive interface with SVG radar waves
Integrated Leaflet geospatial maps with custom atmospheric overlays
architecture: Next.js / React 18 client communicating with an Express.js caching layer over Open-Meteo and OpenAQ endpoints.
challenges: Managing multi-point time series data without frame drops on low-end mobile devices.
additionalDetails: Includes offline caching for favorite geolocations via LocalStorage.

title: Note Saver App
description: A clean Flask web application with Python backend and dynamic HTML/CSS/JS frontend using Jinja2 templates.
overview: A lightweight, distraction-free note management web application built with Python Flask and Jinja2 templating, allowing users to organize thoughts and technical snippets with ease.
problem: Heavyweight note applications suffer from slow startup times and overwhelming feature bloat for everyday quick capture.
solution: A fast, responsive micro-application focused on instant capture, categorization, and persistent storage with minimal resource overhead.
features: Instant note creation with markdown formatting support.
Categorization tags and instant text search.
Minimalist, distraction-free interface.
architecture: Lightweight Flask backend with Jinja2 client-side rendering and SQLite/PostgreSQL storage.
challenges: Maintaining zero-latency state sync on low-bandwidth connections.
